name: Files
description: Files kept on this computer — saved from a shared folder, then attached to emails by name

file.label: saved file {id}
file.title: Saved files
file.description: Files your AI saved, such as PDFs, images, video and text

setupHint: Choose a folder on this computer. Your AI puts files there; the connector keeps a copy of each file you name.

setupGuide.title: Choose the shared folder
setupGuide.description: Create one folder directly in your home folder, for example /Users/anna/suveren-files. Not in Documents, Desktop or Downloads: a Mac does not let the connector read there. Enter its full path under "Shared folder" and press "Save & Encrypt"; the connector then starts. Your AI can suggest a folder and tell you the exact path to type. Later you change it under "Edit credentials". Your AI writes files into the folder, then names a file to the connector. The AI is told the path in its tools, so it never has to ask you. The connector never reads outside this folder and refuses links to other places.

setupGuide.title: Your AI must work on this computer
setupGuide.description: Only an AI that can write to this computer can use the folder, for example an AI app running here. An AI that runs only in the cloud, such as ChatGPT in the browser, cannot reach it and cannot attach files. It can still send emails with text only. You can also drop a file into the folder yourself.

setupGuide.title: Files that can be saved
setupGuide.description: PDF, PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF, MP4, WebM, Markdown and plain text, up to 18 MB. Word, Excel, SVG, HTML and zip files are refused. A saved file never changes; a new version is a new file.

setupGuide.title: Give the Files mandate
setupGuide.description: Saving a file needs a Files mandate. Open Mandates, press "+ New mandate", pick the card Files and press "Give a mandate". On the last step (Sign) give it a title, choose "Review Each Action" or "Automatic", and press "Sign mandate". Your AI refuses to save until you have given it. If you gave your AI a Setup mandate that lists Files, it can propose this one for you to approve.

setupGuide.title: Give the Email mandate that lets the files leave
setupGuide.description: Saving does not send. To let an email carry a saved file, your Email mandate must tick "Saved files" under "What the AI may attach" (new Email mandate, or Edit the existing one and sign it again). Every send is still checked against that mandate. Without the tick the email is refused and your AI stops and asks you.

setupGuide.title: In a team: an admin switches Files and Email on first
setupGuide.description: In a team, a mandate can only be given for a profile the team has enabled. If you see "Not enabled in <team>", ask a team admin to open Team, then "Manage this team in your Authority Server", enable Files and Email, and name who may give their mandates.
